page.content:
Erla is a minor member of the Kikwi tribe. He is found hiding among the grass on a cliff in the Faron Woods. Link must attempt to pick him up in order to speak with him.

Who is Erla?

Erla is a minor member of the Kikwi tribe. He is found hiding among the grass on a cliff in the Faron Woods. Link must attempt to pick him up in order to speak with him.
